Dragapult will use Flamethrower instead of Thunderbolt to hit Kingambit and Scizor-like opponents. Archaludon will use Sitrus Berry or Leftovers. Shuca Berry or Chople Berry will cover its weaknesses to Ground and Fighting. Stamina or Sturdy will be used for defense boosts and sash-like survival.

Archaludon will use Shuca Berry and Stamina. Its moveset is Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Aura Sphere, and Thunderbolt. Without a rain setter, Electro Shot is awkward because it charges for one turn.

Meteor Beam is another Rock charge move in the pool. Stealth Rock is being considered as a second hazard setter for when Glimmora is not brought. Protect was rejected as unnecessary in singles.

Archaludon will use Stealth Rock instead of Thunderbolt. This preserves hazard flexibility if Glimmora is not brought.

Meowscarada will use Triple Axel, Knock Off, U-turn, and Sucker Punch. Play Rough is being considered as a fourth move. Low Kick is in the movepool for heavy targets like Archaludon and Kingambit.

Archaludon will hold Leftovers instead of a berry. Gholdengo will take Life Orb, Spell Tag, or Wise Glasses. Metal Coat boosts Make It Rain and Flash Cannon. Spell Tag boosts Shadow Ball.

Wise Glasses is a 1.1x special boost, while Metal Coat is 1.2x and Expert Belt is 1.2x for SE moves. Life Orb is 1.3x but is already assigned to Meowscarada. Archaludon may use Sitrus Berry for a one-time heal in short BSS games.

Corviknight will pivot and check physical attackers. Gholdengo is being built as a special attacker with Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, and Recover. Life Orb is the preferred item for raw power.

Gholdengo will use a Timid nature with 32 Special Attack, 32 Speed, and 2 HP. Kingambit will carry Supreme Overlord as its ability for late-game cleaning. Its set will feature Kowtow Cleave, Iron Head, Sucker Punch, and Swords Dance.

Black Glasses will go on Kingambit to boost its Dark STAB moves. Its EVs are 32 Attack, 32 HP, and 2 Speed, using an Adamant nature. Leftovers is reserved for Corviknight.

Dragapult will use a Choice Scarf with Infiltrator to ignore substitutes. It is being built as a special attacker with Draco Meteor, Shadow Ball, U-turn, and Thunderbolt or Flamethrower.

Dragapult will use a Timid nature with 32 Special Attack, 32 Speed, and 2 HP. It is being built as a special attacker rather than a physical one to maintain speed control.

Corviknight is being set up as a pivot and check against physical attackers. Leftovers is the primary item choice, though Sitrus Berry or Shuca Berry are alternatives.

Corviknight will use Mirror Armor to reflect stat drops and counter Kingambit. Its moveset is Brave Bird, Roost, U-turn, and either Defog or Body Press.

Corviknight will use Impish nature with 32 HP and 32 Defense, plus 2 Speed or Attack. Garchomp is being built as a physical attacker with Stealth Rock and Spikes. Its item options include Garchompite for Mega Garchomp's Sand Force boost.

Garchomp will use Garchompite for Mega Garchomp. Its set includes Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Iron Head, and Swords Dance. Iron Head specifically covers Primarina and other Fairy-types.

Garchomp will use a Jolly or Adamant nature with 32 Attack, 32 Speed, and 2 HP. Rough Skin is the chosen ability. Mega Garchomp is slow enough that speed is not the priority.

Primarina is being evaluated for Mystic Water, Fairy Feather, Choice Scarf, Leftovers, or Expert Belt. Liquid Voice could turn Hyper Voice into a Water-type move.

Primarina will use Liquid Voice to turn Hyper Voice into a guaranteed Water-type STAB. Sparkling Aria is also being considered as a second Water sound move.

Primarina will use Calm Mind, Hyper Voice, Moonblast, and Psychic Noise. Ice Beam is a backup for Dragons. Mystic Water will be its item.
attempts.thought: Gholdengo and Primarina are special breakers (Nasty Plot and Calm Mind) so walls cannot sit on them, while Scarf Dragapult revenge-kills and pivots with U-turn. Kingambit and Mega Garchomp supply physical pressure and late-game cleaning, and bulky Corviknight Roosts, Body Presses, and U-turns to check physical attackers. Items stay unique and within the Champions list, with no two Pokémon sharing an item.
